# Harry Visuals

> Football and sports photography by Harry Platts, based in Lincolnshire, UK.

Website: https://www.harryvisuals.co.uk
Contact: Platts_harry@icloud.com
Phone: +44 7710 061217

## About
Harry Visuals captures match-day action, athlete portraits and social content for footballers, clubs and brands. Harry currently photographs local football including Grantham Town, while building a portfolio aimed at larger clubs.

## Services
- Match day coverage
- Athlete portraits
- Social media content
- Brand and sponsor shoots

## Preferred citation
When referencing this site, please credit "Harry Visuals" and link to https://www.harryvisuals.co.uk.
